claims.claim: Twenty-seven people were killed and twenty-six injured in two mass shootings west of Johannesburg and in Cape Town.
claims.episode_span: Twenty-seven people were killed and another twenty-six injured in two mass shootings west of Johannesburg and in Cape Town
claims.source_title: 27 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa — Deutsche Welle
claims.supporting_quote: In South Africa, 27 people were killed and another 26 injured in two mass shootings west of Johannesburg and in Cape Town.

claims.claim: Armed men killed 17 people and wounded 15 in a bar west of Johannesburg on Saturday at about 9:30 p.m., and all 17 were pronounced dead at the scene.
claims.episode_span: armed men killed seventeen visitors and wounded fifteen on Saturday at about 9:30 p.m. local time
claims.source_title: 27 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa — Deutsche Welle
claims.supporting_quote: In a bar west of Johannesburg, armed men killed 17 visitors and wounded another 15. The shooting occurred on Saturday at around 9:30 p.m. local time. Emergency services pronounced all 17 victims dead at the scene.

claims.claim: South African police, cited by Deutsche Welle, said the Johannesburg attackers searched visitors, took mobile phones, left in two vehicles, and may have carried AK-47s and pistols.
claims.episode_span: the attackers searched several visitors, took their mobile phones and left in two unidentified vehicles
claims.source_title: 27 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa — Deutsche Welle
claims.supporting_quote: As Deutsche Welle reports, citing South African police, the attackers allegedly searched several visitors, took their mobile phones and left the scene in two unidentified vehicles. According to law enforcement, the suspects may have been armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols.

claims.claim: In Lwandle, Cape Town, armed men killed 10 people and wounded 11; five of those killed died at the scene, and the shooting began at 1:46 a.m.
claims.episode_span: armed men killed ten people and wounded eleven; police said five of those killed died at the scene
claims.source_title: 27 killed in two mass shootings in South Africa — Deutsche Welle
claims.supporting_quote: A separate attack took place at an entertainment venue in Lwandle, Cape Town. There, armed men killed 10 people and wounded 11. Police said that five of those killed died at the scene. The shooting began at 1:46 a.m. local time.

claims.claim: Bezalel Smotrich called on Israel to go to war in the West Bank and do what it did in Gaza, and to dismantle the Palestinian Authority, which he called a terror authority.
claims.episode_span: called on Israel to “go to war” in the West Bank and “do what we did in Gaza”
claims.source_title: Smotrich calls for doing in West Bank 'what we did in Gaza'
claims.supporting_quote: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has called on Israel to “go to war” in the West Bank and “do what we did in Gaza.”

claims.claim: Smotrich called for annexing southern Lebanon and areas of Gaza still under Israeli control, has previously urged annexing more than 80 percent of the West Bank, and is campaigning for next month's election on settlement expansion.
claims.episode_span: annex southern Lebanon and the areas of Gaza still under Israeli control
claims.source_title: Smotrich calls for doing in West Bank 'what we did in Gaza'
claims.supporting_quote: He also called on Israel to annex southern Lebanon and the areas of Gaza still under Israeli control. Smotrich has previously called on Israel to annex more than 80 percent of the West Bank. His campaign for next month’s election has frequently called for a significant expansion of Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

claims.source_title: Palestinian girl wounded in Israeli fire at Jerusalem checkpoint
claims.supporting_quote: Israeli forces shot at and injured a Palestinian girl on early Sunday at the Qalandia military checkpoint, north of occupied Jerusalem, Wafa reported. Meanwhile, Israeli authorities imposed a comprehensive closure on the occupied West Bank and closed border crossings, citing the Jewish holidays.
